capabilities: Upload local images to S3-compatible storage, GitHub, or GitLab
Replace Wiki-link and Markdown image links with public remote URLs
Auto-upload pasted clipboard images and insert remote markup
Batch-upload all images in the current document with progress and failure reports
Rename or recycle local files after successful upload
extras: Desktop-only (Obsidian 1.11.4+); requires publicly accessible URLs since private buckets and signed URLs are unsupported; credentials are stored in Obsidian SecretStorage, not data.json; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian stores pasted and inserted images as local vault files, which bloats the vault and keeps notes tied to local media instead of hosted URLs.

relations.evidence: Currently supports AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, Qiniu S3-compatible API, MinIO, GitHub, and GitLab.
